name: hana-shell-tests
description: Test harnesses for hana-shell. They load the plugin's JS the way the host does (`new Function`) and drive it against a small DOM shim, which is how the drag handling and the render tree get covered — `cargo test` cannot see either. `css-guards` additionally reads the stylesheet, and `css-cascade` runs it through a real cascade.

scripts.test: node tests/css-guards.test.mjs && node tests/css-cascade.test.mjs && node tests/render.test.mjs && node tests/resize.test.mjs
